paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Niteng Thillatte / (Eks 29.38-46)
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, kei a dia gimlim mei a thillat, ka kiang a thillat pen ahun geih in na lan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘My offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, you shall observe to offer to me in their due season.’

paite: Akiang uah, hiai mei a thillat TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Belamnoupa, kum khat a upa, gensiatbei, niteng in nih, halmang thillat alat gige ding ahi.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan ding ua, nitaklam in khat na lan ding uh.
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;

paite: Tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat sathau suk, hin mun li a khen mun khat a hel toh.
english: with the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, gimlim dia Sinai Tang a sehsa halmang thillat lat gige ding ahi.
english: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Belamnou khat latna a dawn thillat, hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi. TOUPA a dia uain, dawn thillat mun siangthou ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

paite: Belamnou khat nitaklam in na lan dia: zingsang lam a tangbuang thillat bang in leh dawn thillat bang in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat na lan ding ahi.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening: as the meal offering of the morning, and as the drink offering of it, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Sabbath ni in belamnoupa kum khat a upa, gensiatbei nih leh tangbuang thillat a ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih sathau a helkhawm leh dawn thillat toh na lat ding ahi.
heading: Sabbath Thillat
english: “‘On the Sabbath day two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and the drink offering of it:

paite: Hiai Sabbath niteng a halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh a halmang thillat lat ding ahi.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Na kha thak teng un TOUPA a dia halmang thil na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Bawngtal chih ah tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum; belam khat a tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;

paite: Belamnou chih ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun khat. Hiai halmang thillat gimlim TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: and a tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Adawn thillat uh bawngtal khat ah uain hin kimkhat ahi dia, belampa khat ah hin mun thum a khen mun khat, belamnou khat ah hin mun li a khen mun khat. Hiai kumtawn a kha teng a halmang thillat ahi.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

paite: TOUPA kiang a khelh thoihna dia kelpa khat na lat ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni TOUPA Paikan ahi.
heading: Silngou Soh Louh Tanghou Kut A Thillatte
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

paite: Huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ahi dia; ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh nek ding ahi.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

paite: Ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou a-om dia; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work;

paite: Mei a thillat bel TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without blemish;

paite: Tangbuang nelte, sathau helkhawm, atangbuang thillat uh toh, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: you shall offer three tenth parts for a bull, and two tenth parts for the ram.

paite: Belamnou sagih bel belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall offer a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

paite: Hiaite zingsang a halmang thillat dawn thillat sim louh a lat gige ding ahi.
english: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Hichibang in TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat nek ding niteng in, ni sagih sung na lan ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Ani sagih ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work.

paite: Na Nipikal Ankuangluina, na buh thak tung ankuangluina TOUPA a dia thil thak tangbuang thillat na lat ni un leng khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Pawltak Kut A Thillatte
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi; ganhopn a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for each bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,

paite: Belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih, belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding kelpa khat toh.
english: one male goat, to make atonement for you.

paite: Haltum thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite dawn thillat toh na lat ding uh ahi, na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, you shall offer them (they shall be to you without blemish), and their drink offerings.
